title: WhatsApp: pairing code only on request, and a Recover missing messages button
text: The WhatsApp tab in the Inbox has a new Recover missing messages button (all staff): it asks the Mac Mini to re-read the phone's last 7 days, saves anything the CRM missed and tells you how many were recovered. The red link banner now has a Get a pairing code button for the owner: codes are made only on request, up to 5 per hour, instead of the Mac making all of them by itself after a logout.
points: The answer can take about a minute, because the Mac checks in once a minute.
Built and rehearsed, but not yet tested on a real logout of the live phone link.
